title: DreamLand
content: Last night I entered a place in MallWorld that I’m certain I wasn’t supposed to go. I remember seeing a really big sign that said DreamLand. I was in the amusement park and a security guard was chasing me so I snuck in to this area. I found a bunch of different rooms, like old studio apartments. inside each one was somebody dreaming something. I don’t know if you guys have ever read Percy Jackson, but there’s a part in the first book where him and his friends get stuck in this casino, and the longer the stay the more they forget how long they’ve been there, and many souls get trapped inside this place for years, decades even. This was exactly what this place felt like. People in every room were visible to me, and I could see what they were dreaming about, but they were stuck and couldn’t see me. As I walked through this strange maze of rooms, I found different dreams from different time periods, one kid was watching old movies on a VCR and box tv over and over endlessly. Then I got to a more abandoned run down area. The rooms here reeked of despair and hopelessness. Somebody I was with told me (or maybe I just realized), that the people in these rooms had been here so long, that they got sick and tired of the good dreams.. they had gone through every good dream imaginable, but still were stuck in dreamland, so they subjected themselves to the bad dreams and nightmares, just to feel and experience something new again. As I saw these people trapped in nightmares, it reminded me of stories of hell. people forced to relive the worst things over and over, trapped for eternity. that’s what this place felt like. I started being chased by security again Somebody told me that we had to get to the BEAN as fast as possible to escape or we would be trapped forever. (they were talking about the bean sculpture in Chicago, interestingly, I looked it up, and the original artist described the bean not as a bean, but as a portal to another world!!!!) I threw a chocolate ice cream to distract the guard, got to the bean, and then I woke up. I haven’t had a MallWorld dream in weeks now, so this one really stuck out, especially seeing the actual name “DreamLand” in my dream, and then seeing other people dreaming, it was pretty vivid and freaky. also the bean thing was really strange, I woke up with goosebumps, and that was before I found out that the artist called it a “portal to another world”.
